test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: The reports of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India relating to accounts of a State are:

options.text: submitted to the Finance Minister of that State for compliance of the audit observations
submitted to the Governor of the State, who shall cause them to be laid before the Legislature of the State
uploaded on the official website of the Comptroller and Auditor-General to enable the general public to know whether the public money has been well spent by the public authorities
submitted to the President, who causes them to be laid before each House of Parliament

solution:
The correct answer is __**submitted to the Governor of the State, who shall cause them to be laid before the Legislature of the State.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The details of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India relating to the accounts of a State shall be **submitted to the Governor of the State, who shall cause them to be laid before the Legislature of the State**.
 
• The Comptroller and Auditor-General give **three inspection reports to the President**: Audit Report on **Appropriation Accounts,** Audit Report on **Finance Accounts, and **Audit Report on **Public Undertakings.**
 
• The role of the** Public Accounts Committee** is to examine the early audit reports of the **Comptroller and Auditor General of India.**
 
• **Article 148** is related to the **Comptroller and Auditor-General of India.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Work of the Comptroller and Auditor General to **audit receipts and expenditures of the Union and every State and the Union Territory Governments.**
 
• The audit reports of the Comptroller and Auditor General are** put down prior to Parliament or the legislature of the State or the Union Territory,** as the case possibly.
 
• The Comptroller and Auditor-General of India is a **representative of the Parliament** and** manages audits of expenditure on behalf of the Parliament. ​ **
